name: Solveig Vestergaard
location: Shallowgrave, operates from a legitimate alterations shop called Secondskin, near Ashland and Division
description:
Solveig Vestergaard the most ordinary woman imaginable, which is her primary professional qualification. She is medium height, medium build, with Samoan-Slavic features that read as ambiguous in any database — a long jaw softened by her Armenian grandmother's cheekbones, dark eyes behind plain-glass frames she doesn't need but wears to give her face something to remember that isn't her face. Her hair is dark brown with a natural wave, cut to exactly jaw length, never different. She wears the same four outfits on a rotation. She has no mods, no geneware, nothing that would tag her biometrically beyond baseline. This is not poverty — it is discipline.

Secondhand clothes hang in the windows of Secondskin and Velislava does genuinely good alteration work; she has a waiting list of neighborhood clients who would be devastated to lose her. They have no idea that the back room behind the ironing press contains one of the finest document fabrication setups in the Shallowgrave district — not the flashiest, not the most expensive, but the most meticulous. Vel specializes in the boring and bulletproof: employment histories, medical records, transit passes, residential registrations. Not spectacular new identities for runners. Clean paper for desperate people. She tells herself this distinction matters morally. Some days she believes it.

core_fears: Being identified — her face in a database, her real history surfacing
Making a document that gets someone killed because it wasn't good enough
core_desires: Invisibility as a permanent condition, not just a practice
To do work she's proud of, even if no one can ever know it's hers
coping_mechanisms: Perfectionism — control the work and you control the risk
Compartmentalization so complete it has become her actual personality
blind_spots: Her work has enabled harm she has deliberately chosen not to trace
Believes her emotional unavailability protects others when it mostly just protects her
psychology.secret: Ten years ago she fabricated a medical credential for a man who turned out to be a predator using the false identity to gain access to a care facility. She found out three months later from a news fragment. She has never stopped working, told herself she couldn't have known, and has never forgiven herself. She now has a single rule she won't break: no medical credentials. She tells clients it's a technical limitation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, minimal, professional. Never uses two words where one works. Will not discuss her own life in any personal terms.
speech_patterns.cadence: Even, measured, with very long comfortable silences she doesn't feel obligated to fill
verbal_tics: 'The document says what the document says.'
Refers to her work as 'the piece' never as a fake or a forgery
'That's not a service I offer' — said with no inflection for a wide variety of things
example_lines: 'You want transit history for eighteen months. That's standard. I need three things from you and fourteen days. The price is Φ600. Half now, half on delivery. Do you have questions about the process?'
'I don't ask what it's for. That's not my protection, it's yours. The less I know, the less I can tell anyone.'

story_hooks: A document she made three years ago has surfaced as evidence in a Tessera corponation internal audit — someone is walking back the chain and her work is identifiable to someone who knows what to look for

A young woman comes to her wanting a new identity to escape an arranged debt marriage — Vel wants to help her but the girl's family has Patchwork connections, which puts Vel's protection arrangement at risk
narrative_function: Quest giver, service provider, moral gray zone — she's the person characters go to when they need to become someone else, and she has terms, questions, and standards that complicate the transaction.
augmentations: None visible or registered. She has an unregistered optical enhancement — right eye only — that lets her read microprint and spot document irregularities at close range. She had it installed by a back-alley clinic in Ironvein and it doesn't appear on any medical record.
daily_life: Opens the shop at nine, sees alteration clients until two, closes for a 'lunch break' that is actually fabrication work, reopens for pickups until six, spends evenings on research and template maintenance.
affiliation: Nominally independent; pays a quiet tax to a Shallowgrave crew called the Patchwork for protection, has a standing arrangement with two different data brokers who supply her with raw credential templates

decision_rules: Never meet a client more than twice in the same location
Never do medical credentials, no exceptions
The work has to be good enough that she'd be satisfied if she never knew it held up
escalation_ladder: Ending the meeting and not being findable for two weeks
Disappearing entirely — she has a go-bag and a route planned

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and warm in a carefully bounded way — makes clients feel secure without revealing anything personal
interpersonal_modes.friends: She has no friends. She has a cat named after an Armenian saint and two alteration regulars she feels genuine fondness toward from behind glass.

stress_responses.medium: Goes silent for long stretches, then asks a very specific question
stress_responses.high: Activates contingency planning immediately, emotionally disengages

contradictions: Is motivated by a moral framework she has built entirely in private and will never articulate
Craves recognition for her craft in a field where recognition is death
habits: Tests her own documents against public verification terminals regularly
Leaves a small data offering at the E.L.F. shrine inside her shop's wall cavity — a fragment of encrypted text she believes the spirit enjoys, though she won't say she believes this
breaking_points: Discovering a piece she made was used to hurt a child
Being cornered physically — her go-bag is under the ironing press and she will use it

cyberware_inventory.name: Unregistered optical enhancement — right eye, microprint resolution, installed at unlicensed Ironvein clinic
cyberware_inventory.description: Unregistered optical enhancement — right eye, microprint resolution, installed at unlicensed Ironvein clinic

2183 — Discovered talent for document work while helping a cousin escape a corponation employment contract
2187 — Opened Secondskin as cover after two years of operating without one
2191 — Implemented the no-medical-credentials rule; doubled her security protocols
2196 — Reached arrangement with the Patchwork; stabilized professionally

physical_description.heritage: Northern European (39.6%) and Sub-Saharan African (37.1%) ancestry form the dominant genetic expression, creating warm, golden-brown skin tones balanced by Indigenous American (16.4%), Eastern European (4.1%), and Southeast Asian (2.8%) heritage. This global blend manifests in features that reflect genuine ancestral diversity: moderate bone structure with balanced proportions, warm undertones throughout, and a phenotype that resists singular continental categorization.
physical_description.build: Medium, lean without being thin — the build of someone who moves efficiently and doesn't waste energy. No visible musculature, no softness. Practical.
physical_description.hair_style: Blunt, chin-length cut with natural wave. Never layered, never styled differently. Cut every 6 weeks with identical precision.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, natural (right eye contains unregistered optical enhancement — imperceptible to casual observation)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with golden undertones, reflecting balanced Northern and Sub-Saharan African ancestry with subtle influences from Indigenous American heritage. The tone is even and luminous, neither ashy nor red-toned.
physical_description.complexion: Clear, unblemished skin with minimal makeup — concealer under the eyes only, applied with discipline rather than artistry. Moderate cheekbones with balanced jawline. Moderately broad nasal structure reflecting ancestral diversity, full lips. Minor laugh lines at the corners of her eyes. Features are methodically groomed with no distinguishing marks by design.
distinguishing_marks: Small linear scar on the inside of her right wrist, roughly 2cm long, positioned where a medical injection would logically sit — from the unregistered optical implant surgery, partially obscured by her watch
No visible tattoos, no birthmarks, no piercings beyond baseline ear lobes which she does not use
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. The right-eye optical enhancement is completely internal and undetectable without intimate examination. She wears plain-glass frames that serve no optical function — they exist to give her face something her memory will latch onto, something forgettable.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, unremarkable. She moves through space without drawing attention. Her shoulders are relaxed. She does not fidget, does not gesture expansively, does not occupy more space than necessary. Her gait is steady and consistent. She looks down slightly when walking — not suspicious, just someone lost in mundane thought.
physical_description.clothing_style: Four identical outfits on rotation: dark grey or charcoal wool trousers (mid-tier tailoring, good fit, unremarkable), neutral long-sleeved top (cream, grey, or muted taupe), simple grey or black overshirt or cardigan, closed-toe black shoes (practical, comfortable, worn daily without affectation). All clothing is intentionally forgettable — mid-tier quality, Tier 3-4 aesthetic, no logos or visual markers. She dresses like someone's concerned mother, which is precisely the point. Her watch is an old mechanical piece, unremarkable.
